input.title: Christmas – Bookish Plot Twist: I Stayed In Ornament
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Plot twist: I stayed in. A bookish ornament for the reader whose best holiday plan is a chair, a stack of books and the cat. A striped armchair, a crocheted blanket, a steaming mug on top of the books, a lamp glowing beside a sleeping cat: the whole scene is on a deep navy disc, with PLOT TWIST: in cream above it and I STAYED IN in mustard gold below.

It is the small, funny gift for the book club friend, the sister who cancels every party for a paperback, or the coworker who has never once been sorry to skip the office mixer. Hang it on the tree, loop it onto a wrapped present, or tuck it in a stocking next to a good bookmark.

The joke lands without any backstory: everyone who has ever turned down plans for a quiet evening with a novel knows exactly who this one is for. The design matches our Plot Twist oversized sweatshirt and cropped hoodie, so a reader can wear the line and hang it too. Each Graphic Tees Co. ornament is printed on glossy ceramic and made to order.

Details & Fit

  • Glossy ceramic ornament, 100% ceramic, circle shape
  • Diameter: 2.76 in (7 cm), thickness: 0.125 in (3 mm)
  • Glossy finish with a white ceramic back
  • Gold-colored string included, ready to hang on the tree
  • Sublimation print
  • Blank product sourced from China

Each ornament is made to order. Ceramic is fragile: hang it on a sturdy branch and wrap it for storage.

Questions

What is the joke on this ornament?
The ornament says PLOT TWIST: I STAYED IN above and below a striped armchair with a stack of books, a mug, a lamp and a sleeping cat. It is the joke every reader tells when the big holiday plan is a chair and a book. Graphic Tees Co. prints it in cream and mustard gold on a navy disc.

What is it made of and how big is it?
This ornament from Graphic Tees Co. is a 100% ceramic circle with a glossy finish and a white back. It measures 2.76 inches (7 cm) across and 0.125 inches thick, so it sits easily on a tree branch or tied to a gift.

How do I hang it?
This ornament comes with a gold-colored string already attached, so you can loop it over a branch, a wreath, a gift ribbon or a hook. It is small and light, so any sturdy branch holds it. Hang it where it will not swing into harder decorations.

How do I care for it?
Wipe this ornament clean with a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth and do not scrub the print. It is ceramic, so it can chip if dropped or knocked against other ornaments. After the holidays, wrap it in tissue and store it in a padded box.

Will it arrive in time for Christmas?
Graphic Tees Co. makes each ornament to order, and orders over $45 ship free in the US. For Christmas, order by about December 8 so it arrives with time to spare. It also works as a stocking stuffer and matches the Plot Twist oversized sweatshirt.
